conversation_owner_first.sql:
SELECT conversations.id, conversations.user_id, conversations.title, conversations.created_at 
FROM conversations 
WHERE conversations.user_id = '00000000000000000000000000000001' ORDER BY conversations.created_at DESC, conversations.id DESC 
 LIMIT 51

conversation_owner_deep.sql:
SELECT conversations.id, conversations.user_id, conversations.title, conversations.created_at 
FROM conversations 
WHERE conversations.user_id = '00000000000000000000000000000001' AND (conversations.created_at < 125 OR conversations.created_at = 125 AND conversations.id < '000000000000000000000000000001f4') ORDER BY conversations.created_at DESC, conversations.id DESC 
 LIMIT 51

SELECT conversations.id, conversations.user_id, conversations.title, conversations.created_at 
FROM conversations 
WHERE conversations.user_id = '00000000000000000000000000000001' AND (conversations.title ILIKE '%%' || 'lesson' || '%%' ESCAPE '/') ORDER BY conversations.created_at DESC, conversations.id DESC 
 LIMIT 51
